description: Multiple- Electrical Meter Readings from Non Residential Buildings is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand", published or maintained by Clayton Miller  (Building and Urban Data Science Lab ). It is an open data set from 507 non-residential buildings that includes hourly whole building electrical meter data for one year. Each of the buildings has meta data such as or area, weather, and primary use type. This data set can be used to benchmark various statistical learning algorithms and other data science techniques. Coverage: Singapore. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy demand. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
